review_method: Independent read-only final-byte control review of the staged amendment, acquisition disposition, strict loader, focused tests, and program documentation.

answers.basis: The disposition closes plan v1 before data binding or strategy results and forbids using the acquired artifact under v1.
The amendment retains all 3,503 mapped raw records through May 29 at 20:00, forbids deletion or filtering, and requires every raw timestamp to remain before June.
The normalized Parquet remains the exact 20-session, 3,120-bar XNYS grid through May 29 at 19:55, and the manifest requested and actual ranges end there.
The amendment changes only the raw transport boundary and preserves the strategy, cost, chronology, screen, stress, neighbor, cohort, June, and terminal rules.
No June or V3 data or protected result was opened. The no-June and no-substitute controls remain unchanged.

The amendment binds the exact base plan, prior review, disposition, acquisition hashes, counts, and ranges. It grants no data-binding, strategy-result, qualification, controlled, holdout, paper, broker-write, or live authority.

scope_limit: Acquisition provenance, validation, and no-June claims were reviewed from immutable metadata only. The review did not open market data, protected results, June or V3 data, or PAPER, broker, live, or strategic-allocation-21 state.
